subject: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Redwood MAP for Acme
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Redwood MAP for Acme

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep alignment across teams. Attaching the MAP spreadsheet (v1) with milestones and owners.

Key pain points you called out:
- High cost per token and unpredictable unit economics across models and cloud regions.
- Latency spikes during peak trading hours causing degraded UX.
- Compliance: need for private deployment options and audit logs for regulated data.

Goals we heard:
- Reduce inference cost by ~30% within 3 months for the highest-volume routes.
- Stabilize 99th percentile latency under 250ms for interactive flows.
- Shortlist a private deployment path (VPC) for regulated workloads and present to procurement by early December.

High-level MAP (attached):
1) Pilot / POC — Redwood Hosted + quantized model profile
   Owner (Acme): Alex Johnson / Maya Patel
   Owner (Redwood): neha_kapoor (Solutions Engineer)
   Milestone: POC environment provisioned and sample traffic run — target: 2026-11-30

2) Evaluation & Cost Modeling — token-level cost breakdowns, latency reports
   Owner (Acme): Maya Patel
   Owner (Redwood): stephanie_nguyen (CS)
   Milestone: cost/latency report & recommendation — target: 2026-12-08

3) Procurement & Security Review — SOC2 docs, architecture diagram, contract terms
   Owner (Acme): Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
   Owner (Redwood): rishi_malhotra (Sales Manager)
   Milestone: Procurement checklist complete & PO/contract in flight — target: 2026-12-15

Decision process we discussed:
- Technical sign-off from Maya (engineering) and Procurement sign-off for commercial terms.
- Target executive review week of 2026-12-06 with final decision by 2026-12-15.

Next steps (for this week):
- Redwood to provision POC access and a sample workload run (neha).
- Acme to share a short sample dataset and SLA expectations (Alex / Maya).
- Schedule 30-min technical deep-dive with Maya and Neha — proposed: Tue 2026-11-23 10:00 PT.

Attachments: Acme-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (milestones, owners, dates)

If anything above doesn't match your view, please flag and I'll update the MAP. Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Redwood MAP for Acme

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and MAP. This lines up with our discussion. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: I've looped in our procurement mailbox (procurement@acme.com) so they can start collecting docs and confirm contract timeline.
- Timeline: Our engineering lead (Maya) wants to validate the POC by 2026-11-30 — she'll confirm the sample dataset early this week.
- Decision: Our exec review is tentatively scheduled for the week of 2026-12-06; target final decision by 2026-12-15 as you noted.
- POC environment: We'll need a short-term sandbox with muted data retention for the initial run. Can Redwood provision a hosted POC with limited retention and logs disabled until security signs off?

I'll have Maya follow up with the data sample and procurement will reach out if they need any specific contract templates.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Redwood MAP for Acme

Appreciate the quick reply, Alex — great to see alignment. Per Maya's ask, we can provision a hosted POC sandbox with:
- Short retention window (48 hours) and an option to purge on demand
- Tracing enabled for the sample traffic but logs masked for PII
- A quantized model variant that matches the performance profile we discussed

Updated MAP milestones & owners (summary):
- 2026-11-23: Technical deep-dive (Neha + Maya) — calendar invite sent.
- 2026-11-30: POC provisioning complete & initial sample run (Neha)
- 2026-12-08: Cost + latency evaluation delivered (Stephaine)
- 2026-12-06 to 2026-12-12: Exec review window (Acme)
- 2026-12-15: Target decision / contract in flight (Procurement)

Owners:
- Acme: Alex Johnson (exec sponsor), Maya Patel (engineering), Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Neha Kapoor (SE), Stephanie Nguyen (CS), Rishi Malhotra (Sales Manager)

Action items assigned: 
- Redwood (Neha): provision hosted POC sandbox by 2026-11-30 and share access details in the Drive link.
- Acme (Maya): share sample dataset and any ingestion instructions by 2026-11-22.
- Procurement (Procurement): share preferred contract template and any security question deadlines by 2026-11-29.

I'll attach the MAP v1 (spreadsheet) and the HubSpot deal link in case procurement needs it. Let me know if you'd like me to introduce any legal contacts from Redwood.

Regards,
Marissa
